## 2023-10-25 — Send Strategy to Case Tracker
**Product understood as:** An AI legal co-pilot that provides case strategies and timelines, alongside a separate case tracker.
**Derivation reasoning:** This product has justice_ai_history (chat analysis logs) and a disconnected justice_ai_case_tracker_v2 (procedural timelines). Users get a strategy & timeline generated by AI in the chat, but there is no mechanism to track that timeline because it is completely disconnected from the Case Tracker feature. Therefore users obviously need a way to push their AI-generated case strategy directly into the Case Tracker, creating a personalized, tracked procedural case. It doesn't exist because the chat and tracker modules were likely built sequentially and not deeply integrated. I'm building it because users shouldn't have to manually re-type their AI-generated steps into the tracker.
**Feature built:** A 'Track Strategy' button in the chat analysis panel that automatically converts the AI-generated timeline into a tracked case in the Case Tracker.
**User impact:** Users can now seamlessly convert their AI legal consultation directly into a structured, trackable case with one click.
**Next logical feature:** Integrating the timeline deadlines directly into a unified user calendar.
